reel.hook: the viewer's own question, short: 'Will the weight come back?'
reel.order: one numbers line from c000-01: after stopping a weight management medication, weight came back at an average 0.4 kg a month (95% confidence interval 0.3 to 0.5), in adults with overweight or obesity; on the same line keep 'on average', 'not a prediction for you' and the exact phrase 'not only GLP-1' (the only allowed mention of GLP-1; never name another drug)
reel.brand_line: Before you start, hear it from a doctor, not a reel.
